claims.text: The proposed intervention is to integrate machine learning, CALPHAD, and ab initio molecular dynamics.
The target material initially is a solid multicomponent high-entropy material.
The approach is intended for high-temperature, compositionally complex, near-equiatomic systems.
Configurational entropy mediates the effect of the proposed intervention on the predicted thermodynamic properties.
Short-range ordering mediates the effect of the proposed intervention on the predicted thermodynamic properties.
Machine learning can efficiently screen the vast compositional space of high-entropy materials.
Machine learning can efficiently analyze the vast compositional space of high-entropy materials.
CALPHAD provides a thermodynamic framework for determining phase stability in multicomponent alloys.
Ab initio molecular dynamics accurately predicts the relevant thermodynamic properties of multicomponent high-entropy materials near the solid-to-fluid transition.
The integrated approach will improve the accuracy and efficiency of transition-temperature determination relative to CALPHAD or ab initio molecular dynamics alone.
The integrated approach will improve the accuracy and efficiency of fusion-enthalpy determination relative to CALPHAD or ab initio molecular dynamics alone.
The integrated approach will improve the accuracy and efficiency of fusion-entropy determination relative to CALPHAD or ab initio molecular dynamics alone.
The integrated approach will improve the accuracy and efficiency of volume-change determination relative to CALPHAD or ab initio molecular dynamics alone.
The integrated approach will improve the accuracy and efficiency of dense-fluid heat-capacity determination relative to CALPHAD or ab initio molecular dynamics alone.
The approach is limited to near-equiatomic high-entropy materials at high temperatures.
Machine-learning accuracy depends strongly on the size and quality of the training dataset.
Integrating CALPHAD and ab initio molecular dynamics may require significant computational resources.
